questions.question_text: Which organization's headquarters is located in Geneva, Switzerland?
questions.explanation: The World Health Organization (WHO) is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.

questions.question_text: Which river is known as the lifeblood of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Indus River is the longest and most vital river for Pakistan's agriculture and economy.

questions.question_text: Who is the current Secretary-General of the United Nations?
questions.explanation: António Guterres assumed office as the UN Secretary-General on January 1, 2017.

questions.question_text: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.explanation: Mars appears red due to iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

questions.question_text: The G20 summit 2024 was hosted by which country?
questions.explanation: Brazil held the G20 presidency for 2024.

questions.question_text: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen makes up approximately 78% of the Earth's atmosphere.

questions.question_text: Which historical monument was built by Shah Jahan for his wife Mumtaz Mahal?
questions.explanation: The Taj Mahal is an ivory-white marble mausoleum commissioned by Shah Jahan.

questions.question_text: What is the capital city of Japan?
questions.explanation: Tokyo is the capital and largest city of Japan.

questions.question_text: Which scientist developed the theory of General Relativity?
questions.explanation: Albert Einstein published the theory of general relativity in 1915.

questions.question_text: The 'Nobel Peace Prize' is awarded in which city?
questions.explanation: While most Nobel Prizes are awarded in Stockholm, the Peace Prize is awarded in Oslo, Norway.

questions.question_text: Which organization focuses on global health?
questions.explanation: The World Health Organization (WHO) is a specialized agency of the UN responsible for international public health.
